sources.entry: browserosaurus - macOS tool that prompts you to choose a browser when opening a link.

summary.one_liner: Browserosaurus is an open-source macOS app that acts as the default browser and asks you which installed browser to open each clicked link in; the project is no longer maintained.
summary.what_it_does: Browserosaurus sets itself as the default browser on macOS. When a link is clicked in a non-browser app, it is sent to Browserosaurus, which shows a menu of all installed browsers so you can choose which one opens the link. The README says it is licensed under GPLv3. Installation is available as a download from the GitHub releases page (x64 for Intel, arm64 for Apple Silicon) or via Homebrew cask. The README also lists documentation topics such as supporting a new browser or app, development setup, and a changelog. It names two forks: Browseratops for Windows and Browserino, a Swift UI port.
use_cases: choose which browser opens a link
pick a browser per link from non-browser apps
set a default browser prompter on macOS
route links to different browsers by app
install a browser selector via Homebrew
notable: Acts as the system default browser and presents a menu of installed browsers for each link
Separate builds for Intel (x64) and Apple Silicon (arm64)
Forks exist for Windows (Browseratops) and Swift UI (Browserino)
caveats: No longer maintained, per the README notice at the top
Officially supports only the latest stable macOS version the author uses
